Our Lady’s Saturday

Sanctæ Mariæ Sabbato · Simplex

Read in Latin and English

Lesson I

De libro secúndo Machabæórum

2 Mac 15:25-28

Nicánor autem et qui cum ipso erant, cum tubis et cánticis admovébant. Lesson II

2 Mac 15:32-34

A sermon of St. Bernard, Abbot
